name: Nick
title: Muay Thai Coach
excerpt: From Kyokushin Karate to Muay Thai, Coach Nick brings over two decades of striking experience and world-class training lineage to every class.
bio:
Coach Nick's journey in martial arts began at age 11, when he started training in Kyokushin Karate, a discipline he trained in consistently for 16 years. At 27, he moved to the United States, where he began training kickboxing under legendary coach Benny "the Jet" Urquidez. He spent 5 years refining his kickboxing under Urquidez before transitioning to Muay Thai, training at MTA North Hollywood under Kru Puk.

With a foundation built across multiple striking disciplines and decades of hands-on training under respected coaches, Nick brings a rare depth of technical knowledge and real-world experience to every class he teaches.
